artworks.title: The Witch of Malleghem
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a densely packed scene with various figures and objects. The scene depicts fantastical characters engaged in different activities around tables with jugs and cups. The environment is lively with intricate details in each figure's attire and expression. There are oversized fruit, baskets, ladders, buildings in the distance, and ships in the background. Objects include a devilish creature on a barrel and a figure crouched in a large egg, adding ambiguity and humor. This illustration is reminiscent of works by Pieter Bruegel the Elder, with a whimsical and complex composition creating a narrative richness.

artworks.title: The Witch of Malleghem
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder

artworks.title: Epileptics Walking to the Right
artworks.artist: Hendrik Hondius I after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows six men walking closely together in a line. They are standing and walking forward, holding onto each other's arms or shoulders. Their facial expressions are varied, with different features such as closed eyes, squinting, mouths slightly open, long noses, and furrowed brows. Their hair ranges from short to long and disheveled. They are dressed in long robes and simple attire like tunics, pants, and shoes, without any visible jewelry or objects. The background features a natural setting with trees of varying heights, a path leading into the distance, and a small countryside scene with structures resembling houses or barns. The landscape extends to show distant silhouettes of buildings or towers, suggesting a rural environment.

artworks.title: A Dutch Hulk and a Boeier
artworks.artist: Frans Huys and Cornelis Cort? after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed engraving of a seascape with a large ship at the center. The perspective shows the sea, ships, and distant city structures. The artwork features intricate line work in shades of brown and beige, highlighting textures and patterns. Waves surround the ships, and dramatic clouds fill the sky.

artworks.title: The Fat Kitchen
artworks.artist: anonymous Netherlandish 17th Century engraver, after Pieter van der Heyden, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.8 x 28.2 cm (8 9/16 x 11 1/8 in.)

artworks.title: Christ and the Adultress
artworks.artist: Pieter Perret after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered around a central figure who is kneeling on the ground. The figure is seen from head to toe, kneeling forward with one hand extended towards the ground, with facial features partially visible beneath a hood and long flowing hair. The central figure's head is tilted down, gazing at a spot on the ground where there are writings. He is dressed in a long robe that covers most of his body. To his left stands a female figure, visible from head to toe, wearing a long dress that accentuates her waist, holding her hands together in front of her. Surrounding them is a crowd of men and women, some in long robes, some with hats or head coverings. They exhibit varied expressions and postures, with one leaning forward with a stick pointing towards the ground. The background consists of a dense assembly of people with indistinct architectural elements visible beyond them.

artworks.title: The Misanthrope Robbed by the World
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a robed figure and a person trapped inside a sphere. The central feature shows a hooded figure walking in front of a windmill, while a smaller figure is partially caught in a round object with a sword protruding from it. The smaller figure reaches towards the larger figure. In the background, various figures are engaged in dynamic interactions, such as a cart with horses and soldiers, indicating motion and activity. The landscape includes hills and clouds in the sky, contributing to the mood. There is ornate script in an older language around the central circle, potentially conveying an allegorical or moral message.

artworks.title: The Archbishop Blessing the Child after the Baptism
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 22.1 x 19.7 cm (8 11/16 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals in an ornate architectural setting with arches and columns. In the center, a person with a crown and long garments holds a child wrapped in cloth. To the left, a group of people wearing various hats and cloaks engage with the central figures. On the right, another individual wears a decorative floral hat and detailed outfit. The figures appear to be interacting, with one figure to the left holding a staff. Above them, through the arches, there are depictions of trees or foliage adding detail to the background, which features an intricately designed ceiling or entablature.

artworks.title: The Archbishop Blessing the Child after the Baptism
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures standing in an architectural setting. The image shows detailed lines illustrating figures dressed in ornate garments, in an interior with pillars and arches. Each figure wears richly textured robes, hats, and capes. The dense line work and intricate details add depth to the garments and setting. The figures are positioned in a way that suggests a narrative scene within a historical or biblical context.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image shows an angel standing on clouds, pointing upwards with one hand and holding a flower in the other. The angel's body is turned to the right, with delicate facial features and curly hair. They wear flowing robes with detailed drapery. To the right, a woman kneels wearing a long draped garment and a hood, with serene and focused facial expression, hands over her chest. The scene is filled with angels in the sky, surrounded by clouds and emitting rays of light. A bird descends with rays radiating downwards. The setting features decorative columns and patterned floors, suggesting an interior space.

artworks.title: The Drunken Silenus ("The Tazza Farnese")
artworks.description: This image shows a classical pastoral scene with mythical creatures tending to a reclining figure in a decorative circular border. The scene includes fauns or satyrs interacting with the reclining figure, surrounded by a wreath of leaves and vines. The setting is lush with foliage and an intricate frame. The drawing features detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Tournament of Love
artworks.description: The image features numerous figures engaged in various activities, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene includes trees and detailed brushstrokes creating texture and depth, with a sepia color palette. The composition is framed by a decorative border of floral and leaf motifs.

artworks.title: Alphonse Daudet
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of an individual's head and a portion of their shoulders, in a contemplative pose. The person is slightly turned to the side with their face tilted downward. The facial features are softly rendered, emphasizing the eyes, nose, and beard. The individual has a bushy beard and their hair appears to be gently swept back. Clothing is not distinctly visible. There is no jewelry or objects being held. The background is a dark, textured field.

artworks.title: Henry II of France
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in regal attire, standing in a noble pose. He has sharp facial features, a beard, and curly hair. A laurel wreath rests on his head, and he wears detailed armor with mythological engravings. He holds a rod with a fleur-de-lis and rests his hand on a shield with a lion's face. The background is plain, with text identifying him as "Henricus II Francorum Rex."

artworks.title: Farmyard in Winter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a rustic homestead and its surroundings. The sky is filled with thick, gray clouds with patches of blue. In the distance, there are silhouettes of bare trees partially obscured by snow. The illustration is detailed, capturing the branches of trees and the texture of roofs and structures. The color palette is soft, with browns, grays, and white dominating. Close by, a pig is visible, along with three figures standing near a wooden sled. Snow-covered trees in the distance complete the rural scene.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. It shows soldiers armed with spears and banners, accompanied by cavalry units on horseback. The foreground includes fallen figures and a cannon wheel on the ground. The left side of the drawing shows ranks of troops. The background is a wide landscape under a cloudy sky. The overall composition and use of shadows highlight the tension and movement within the conflict.

artworks.title: The Dance on the River Bank (La danse au bord de l'eau)
artworks.description: The image displays an etched landscape featuring a panoramic scene with human figures and nature. In the foreground, a group of people are gathered with animals nearby. A river flows horizontally near the horizon, where an old stone building with a tower and waterwheel is situated among trees. Hills in the distance add depth to the scene. The etching technique uses fine lines to depict texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Departure for the Fields (Le départ pour les champs)
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene with goats being herded by figures, one of whom is riding a donkey. A distant horizon shows mountains and a village. The sky above is textured with fine, horizontal lines. The intricate brushstrokes depict trees, foliage, animals, and human figures. The trees bend to the right of the composition, while rocks and architecture in the distance show precise line detail. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: The Herd at the Watering Place (Le troupeau à l'abreuvoir)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with cows gathered at a river to drink. A shepherd is overseeing them. The landscape includes hills in the distance and a small structure atop one of the hills on the right side. The etching features intricate lines creating textures in the trees, cows, and landscape. The color palette is sepia. The cows are shown drinking or resting, with the shepherd nearby. A large tree offers shade, and the hills have sparse vegetation. In the background, an architectural structure can be seen on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Roman Forum (Le Campo Vaccino)
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is positioned towards the top third of the image, where distant buildings and hills meet the sky. In the foreground, there are figures among stone and architectural remnants, while the middle distance shows more activity with people and carriages. Architectural landmarks with columns and arches are visible in the distance. The image is rendered with line work and crosshatching, suggesting an etching technique. The color palette is primarily brown, creating contrast and detail. Trees frame the left side of the image.

artworks.title: The Journey to Constantinople
artworks.description: This image shows a wide, panoramic view with many figures and architectural elements. The horizon is at the top, with various structures and trees in the background. The artwork features detailed line work in a monochromatic color palette of shades of grey and black. Closest to us, figures are engaged in different activities, leading to more groups of figures in the middle ground and a distant background with buildings and landscapes.

artworks.title: After the Shipwreck
artworks.artist: Attributed to Simon Novellanus after Cornelis Cort
artworks.description: The image features an engraving showing a rocky and wooded landscape with large trees, rocks, mountains, a distant settlement, a shipwreck on a rocky shore, the sea, birds in flight, swirling cloud formations, and a detailed and textured appearance through intricate line work. The color palette consists mainly of black and white.

artworks.title: The Shipwreck
artworks.artist: Attributed to Simon Novellanus after Cornelis Cort
artworks.description: The image shows a turbulent sea with debris and barrels scattered over the waves. In the distance, there is a small town with buildings, a tower on a rocky outcrop, and mountains and hills extending into the distance. The stormy sky is above the sea. The artwork is detailed with intricate line work resembling etching or engraving in black ink on paper, with shading and cross-hatching for texture and contrast. In the foreground, a figure is running from the chaos.

artworks.title: Country House with a Ditch
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with buildings and livestock viewed from across a body of water. The horizon is higher in the composition, aligned with tree tops. The buildings have a traditional architectural style with gabled roofs and chimneys. Detailed linework and cross-hatching are used to create a textured effect on trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. Three oxen are in the water, leading towards a wooden structure and a narrow bridge. Birds are seen flying in the sky.
